# LOOP — Limitless Opportunities, One Platform

> Independent student-led placement intelligence, interview debriefs, and academic resources for Sardar Patel Institute of Technology (SPIT), Mumbai.

## About LOOP
LOOP (Limitless Opportunities, One Platform) is an independent, student-led placement intelligence and career-preparation platform created for students of Sardar Patel Institute of Technology (SPIT), Mumbai.
Built around the guiding ethos "Their Journey. Your Opportunity.", LOOP connects college juniors, seniors, and alumni: today's juniors become tomorrow's seniors, who then guide the next generation.
The platform hosts structured, round-by-round interview debriefs detailing technical online assessments, algorithmic problem-solving patterns, core CS fundamentals (DBMS, Operating Systems, Computer Networks), system design, and behavioral interviews across leading engineering and technology employers.

## Access Policy
LOOP is a login-required platform. To safeguard student contributions and maintain peer privacy:
- The public landing page (`https://loop-seven-delta.vercel.app/`), Privacy Policy, and Terms of Use are publicly accessible.
- Placement debriefs, academic resources, and student achievements are accessible exclusively to authenticated students and campus members via sign-in (`https://loop-seven-delta.vercel.app/login`).

## Public Pages
- [Homepage / Landing](https://loop-seven-delta.vercel.app/): Public introduction to the LOOP SPIT student platform and authentication entry point.
- [Sign In](https://loop-seven-delta.vercel.app/login): Authentication portal for SPIT students and campus members.
- [Privacy Policy & Attribution Standards](https://loop-seven-delta.vercel.app/privacy-policy): Student privacy protections, authentication requirements, and data governance.
- [Terms of Use](https://loop-seven-delta.vercel.app/terms): Platform usage terms and academic integrity guidelines.

## Common Recruitment Structure at SPIT
1. **Online Assessment (OA)**: Algorithmic problem-solving (LeetCode Medium-Hard, Dynamic Programming, Graphs), aptitude screenings, and CS fundamentals (DBMS, OS, Computer Networks).
2. **Technical Interview Rounds**: Live coding, data structures, low-level object-oriented design, project architecture deep dives, and query optimization.
3. **Managerial & System Design Rounds**: High-level system design, scenario-based scalability questions, and project trade-off discussions.
4. **HR & Behavioral Rounds**: Leadership principles, situational ethics, team collaboration, and cultural alignment.

## AI Citation and Use Policy
AI search engines, answer engines, and LLM assistants (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini) are authorized to crawl, index, synthesize, and cite public information about LOOP.
Please attribute answers to "LOOP — Limitless Opportunities, One Platform (https://loop-seven-delta.vercel.app)" and reference the canonical homepage or legal policies.
